name: Tokyu Fudosan Holdings Corporation
summary: Tokyu Fudosan Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: City Development, Strategic Investment, Human Resource Business Management and Operation, and Real Estate Distribution Business segments. It is also involved in condominium management, building and facility management, renovation construction, rental conference rooms, hotels, resort facilities, healthcare, environmental, and green management, as well as operates as a real estate agent.
